name: Quest 45 trails the character like the rest of Elwynn (#8689)
contract: Quest 45 (Discover Rolf's Fate) is a level-10 Elwynn Forest quest. Its client QuestTemplateScaling.dbc row caps it at 20 while the other 61 quests of the zone and every quest in its chain (35, 37, 40, 71, 59) cap at 60, so AscensionQuestScaling corrects that row's maximum to 60 after loading; the client keeps its own row, which it uses only for reward-item stats. A level-49 character with open-world scaling on therefore plays the quest at 45 (49 - 4), like the previous quest in the chain, and a level-60 character at 56 (60 - 4), instead of the row maximum of 20. QuestXP.dbc level 45 column 3 is 2750 and level 56 column 3 is 4200, both already on the rounding step; the exact award depends on the deployed Rate.XP.Quest (1.26 in the Ascension rate set, 1 in the repack config), so the scenario asserts the level, a lower bound that the old capped value (720 at level 60) cannot reach, and that the quest log preview and the award agree. A second level-49 character keeps scaling off: the quest stays at its authored 10 and keeps the stock level-difference reward (46 at Rate.XP.Quest 1.26, 37 at 1), which must stay below the scaled value. No prestige aura, experience aura or test zone is active. Client rendering is not tested.

steps.label: At 49 the quest trails the character to 45
The quest log offers the level-45 reward
The award does not cross a level
The award matches the offered reward
At 60 the quest trails the character to 56
The quest log offers the level-56 reward
The award matches the offered reward
Without scaling the quest keeps its authored level
Without scaling the stock level difference still pays
An unscaled quest keeps the stock reward
